blocks.text: Biodiversity ka lafz “biological diversity” se bana hai. Is ka matlab hai mukhtalif ecosystems mein maujood zindagi ki shaklon ki variety (rang-a-rangi), jis mein species, genes aur ecosystems teenon ki diversity shamil hai. Yeh jandaron ki kasrat aur farq (richness aur variability), aur un ke aapas ke aur apne mahol (environment) ke saath taalluqaat (interactions) ko zahir karti hai.

blocks.title: Ecosystem
blocks.text: Ecosystem ek zinda, harkat karta hua (dynamic) system hai jis mein jandar aur un ka physical mahol (paani, mitti, hawa, roshni wagaira) ek doosre par asar daalte hain. Is mein tamam biotic factors (zinda cheezein) aur abiotic factors (be-jaan cheezein) shamil hain.

blocks.title: Niche
blocks.text: Niche kisi jandar ya species ka ecosystem mein kirdar (role) ya kaam hai. Is mein us ka habitat (rehne ki jagah), doosre jandaron ke saath us ke taalluqaat (predation yani shikaar, competition yani muqabla, aur symbiosis yani saath reh kar faida), aur ecosystem mein energy ke bahao mein us ka kirdar shamil hai.
